reviews.title: Premiums
reviews.text: You’re not getting the slightest chance of getting any special pokemon if you don’t pay your way for it stupid how you have to pay so much money just to get a place that normally most people leave

reviews.title: Forced adds prevents raids
reviews.text: Joined a raid room, spent 100 coins boosting it and got a forced Ad - couldn’t add the host & they started without me. Waste of time & money 👎🏼

reviews.title: Game is bugged and p2w
reviews.text: The game never creates my raid ad and when it does its at the bottom of the waiting list. Its impossible to get people to join unless ur doing express raids . I have an iphone 17 pro so its not my phone being bad its the game

reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.text: Would be a 5 star rating from me but I’m getting fed up with constant pop ups telling me to enable push notifications or register my location. I don’t want to do it. At all. Stop asking me every single time I use the app the answer is no.

reviews.title: Where are the raids?
reviews.text: Every god damn raid you click on is full or expired? Why display raids that aren’t available? And the ads! I’m getting ads for just scrolling the app? It’s not like I’m watching it pre/post raid for gods sake…I’ll stick with poke genie, much easier to navigate and land a raid

reviews.title: Raid
reviews.text: Waited hours for a raid, when I got into the message group host said they would send invites and never did, wasted all that time waiting and never got the coins back to try again either. What’s a waste of time

reviews.title: Opaque/Misleading pricing
reviews.text:
Requires subscription for good raids (fair enough) but buries pricing inside a “mega subscription” for 1000 coins - not included in app purchase list here. You get a 50 coin discount on your first raid When you get to join, the price of auto join is 5000 coins. Which strangely wasn’t clear when I paid. Absolute con. Avoid. I have complained to Apple for misleading sales
